svg.text: where you can get to, and which buses take you there (July 2026)
Find where you want to go, around the edge of the diagram.
Follow its coloured line in to Aldi at the centre.
The badges on that line are the buses that go there.
Reachable destinations & routes serving them, from the UK Bus Open Data Service (Open Government Licence v3.0), cross-checked with
operators (July 2026). Confirm live times & fares at bustimes.org or operator apps. Journey times shown are approximate. Diagram — not
